title: Use Sonnet, not Opus, for question-only journey and practice coaching

source.ref: Review of the Codex AI coaching overhaul, 2026-10-26

detail: journey-edit, journey-composition and practice-edit asked the most expensive model tier for at most four short questions of at most 280 characters each (600 output tokens), at up to five calls a minute per author. They now use Sonnet, the same tier as the practice spark; the caller-attribution check pins the new tier. Owner go-ahead: Daniel, 'update the AI caller tier pin', 2026-10-26.

verify.note: Exits 0 once the three question-only coaches no longer use Opus.
